snippet.title: Egg Hunt 2026: The Grand Eggspress - Main Trailer
snippet.description:
Meet Pip, and travel to faraway lands on the Eggspress in Egg Hunt 2026: The Grand Eggspress! Meet inquisitive characters, solve challenging puzzles, and collect over 120 eggs across spore-filled forests, ancient ruins, and lava filled trenches. 

Will you solve the mystery of the Century Egg?

Egg Hunt 2026: The Grand Eggspress launches on Roblox on July 29th, 2026. This is the spiritual successor of Egg Hunt 2018: The Great Yolktales developed by Studio Koi Koi and GeekOut.

Pre-order here: https://www.roblox.com/games/116860802165353/Egg-Hunt-2026-The-Grand-Eggspress

Trailer made by the community trailer company FramePoint.
